name: MYB binding protein 1a

function.text: MYBBP1A encodes myb-binding protein 1A. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity and E-box binding. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

function.text: MYBBP1A encodes myb-binding protein 1A. Based in part on similarity, it may activate or repress transcription via interactions with sequence specific DNA-binding proteins. Repression may be mediated at least in part by histone deacetylase activity (HDAC activity). It functions as a corepressor and in concert with CRY1, represses the transcription of the core circadian clock component PER2.
